description: This file defines the SlowConsumingPressureMonitor class, which implements the ICachePressureMonitor interface to monitor cache pressure based on message ingestion speed, especially for slow consumers in Azure Event Hubs streaming context.

classes.name: SlowConsumingPressureMonitor
classes.description: A pressure monitor class that tracks cache pressure and determines if the system is under pressure, tailored for slow consumers controlling flow based on cache pressure metrics.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a new cache pressure contribution and updates the maximum pressure in the current window.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines whether the cache is under pressure based on the maximum pressure in the current window and manages pressure state transitions.
